messages.subject: Odd localhost behavior
parts:
Hi All,

Ever since I updated my mac to OSX 10.9, this weird thing has been happening when working on shiny.  Before, I would edit code, save, then refresh the browser, which would instantly reflect the new code.  Now, however, when I refresh the browser, it gets hung up ... the little refresh circle keeps going and going but never finishes.  The weird solution is to quickly toggle over to the R console, then quickly toggle back to the browser and it finishes refreshing.  I do nothing when I toggle to the console ... just make it the active window for a split second.

Am I the only one?  Any idea what might be causing this?

I'm on Chrome v31.0.1650.63, R v3.0.2, OSX 10.9.

John
